verdict.rationale: GitHub docs explicitly describe assigning Copilot as a reviewer for PRs ('Assign initial reviews to Copilot for greater speed and quality') and Copilot Autofix analyzing and applying fixes for vulnerabilities during review workflows, plus agent mode explaining and generating code edits. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating review-comment suggestions in practice and more detail on the review-fix UX flow.
